message.content:
With 2 crews at Palangkaraya, Central Kalimantan, the test shows crew 1 visits C4 near Tongkiling, C11, and C2 near Sei Ahas covering 188.1 risk, and crew 2 visits C7 near Matangai and C6 near Mentangaik covering 87.1 risk.

You would still miss P1 C3 near Dandang with 63.5 risk and C8 near Bassiri with 37.1 risk in Central Kalimantan.

This assumes bases are provincial capitals, 10 hour days, 30 km/h and 2 hours on site. Visiting is not extinguishing.
